description:
Get details for a Sentry uptime monitor, including recent checks.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Inspect an uptime monitor's URL, interval, thresholds, and status
- Review recent HTTP check results (success/failure, status code, duration)
- Debug why an uptime monitor is failing

This is separate from cron monitors (`get_monitor_details`).

Request bodies are never returned. Sensitive header values are redacted.
To find related issues, call `search_issues` with query `uptime_rule:<id>`.

<examples>
get_uptime_monitor_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', projectSlug='backend', uptimeMonitorId='12345')
get_uptime_monitor_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', projectSlug='backend', uptimeMonitorId='12345', period='7d', checkLimit=20)
</examples>

checkLimit.description: Maximum number of recent checks to include.

end.description: Absolute end time. Must be provided with `start`; do not combine with `period`.

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

period.description: Relative time range for recent checks. Defaults to `24h` when `start` and `end` are omitted.

projectSlug.description: The project's slug. You can find a list of existing projects in an organization using the `find_projects()` tool.

anyOf.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

start.description: Absolute start time. Must be provided with `end`; do not combine with `period`.

name: get_uptime_monitor_details

assertion.description: Response assertion tree as configured in Sentry, or null when none is set.

hasRequestBody.description: Whether a request body is configured. The body is never returned.

headers.description: Configured request headers; sensitive values are redacted.

title: Get Uptime Monitor Details
